title: Strong fields head to Switzerland as Sierre-Zinal celebrates 50th edition
claims: World Athletics describes the 2023 running as the 50th edition of Sierre-Zinal.
The same preview states that the final 7 km is downhill and that the finish is at 1,680 m.
The same preview states that both course records fell in 2019, with Kilian Jornet clocking 2:25:35 and Maude Mathys 2:49:20, and that Mathys later lowered the women's mark to 2:46:03.

verification.note: 2026-11-08 直取世界田联 2023 赛前稿。该稿写于 2024 年之前，故男子纪录仍写 2:25:35；官网现纪录页已更新为 2024 年 Jornet 2:25:34。女子 2:46:03 与官网纪录页的 2:49:20 冲突，官网冠军表脚注说明 2020 与 2021 届成绩不作官方承认。
